# exo_accepted_domain (Data Source)

Look up an existing AcceptedDomain object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `can_have_cloud_cache` (Boolean) Maps to the -CanHaveCloudCache parameter.
- `domain_type` (String) Maps to the -DomainType parameter.
- `enable_nego2_authentication` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableNego2Authentication parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `mail_flow_region` (String) Maps to the -MailFlowRegion parameter.
- `match_sub_domains` (Boolean) Maps to the -MatchSubDomains parameter.
- `outbound_only` (Boolean) Maps to the -OutboundOnly parameter.
- `sending_from_domain_disabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -SendingFromDomainDisabled parameter.
- `sending_to_domain_disabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -SendingToDomainDisabled parameter.
